name: The Liquidators

tenures.note: Billed against Wild Tendencies on the 7 November 2004 card, the two members having shaken hands after their own prior match the week before.

caption: A tag team billed against Wild Tendencies on the AEWF's 7 November 2004 card, its own two members having shaken hands after a prior match the week before.

name: Wild Tendencies

tenures.note: Lost to Man & Superman by disqualification on the 31 October 2004 Touring Main Event after Thog bit "Superman" Stefan Kohl's neck; Thog then assaulted the AEWF medical team and was restrained by security. Billed as a team against the Liquidators on the 7 November 2004 card.

caption: Billed as a team against the Liquidators on the AEWF's 7 November 2004 card; no individual roster survives.

name: Man & Superman

tenures.note: Defeated Wild Tendencies by disqualification on the 31 October 2004 Touring Main Event after Thog bit Kohl's neck.

caption: A tag team that defeated Wild Tendencies by disqualification on the AEWF's 31 October 2004 Touring Main Event.
